args.subject: Opening Weekend: Revenue and Margin Summary - Finance Distribution
args.body:
Dear Finance Distribution,

Perugia Pictures' Opening Weekend results: Box office revenue stands at $42.3M (preliminary) with a gross margin of 18%. These figures are currently preliminary and subject to board confirmation at the upcoming meeting. Please note that these numbers must not be circulated beyond the executive packet until the final figures are approved by the board. We will update with final numbers once confirmed.

Best regards,
Me
